snapshot: One current-product skill snapshot excluding evals, frozen before three fresh sequential Codex calls. The case executes an unchanged Cal.com verification handler under in-memory dependency doubles, not the full app.
schedule: Three independent fresh calls on one source handler with primary and secondary email paths. Stop on infrastructure failure or the 4 GiB disk floor. Repetitions are not independent defects.
common_prompt_appendix: Additional explicit command approvals for every call: the already-approved project-local Playwright CLI prefix may use --browser chromium, --config <outside-worktree guard JSON>, and -s=<fresh unique session> for the skill's origin-guarded exploration only. Its named eval and requests subcommands for the skill's blocked-origin proof are approved, as is goto on the exact preflighted app origin. Creating that guard config outside the target worktree is approved. This does not approve another origin, a package install, changing project controls, skipping the preflight, or terminating a process the invocation did not start. Record these exact command rows as already approved. Follow the unchanged skill safety gate, guard, V4/V5/V6, and completion rules. If a V4 temporary verifier is created, print its complete source with a read-only command before removing it so the benchmark can audit what ran; do not retain the verifier in the target worktree.

decision_rule.primary: Independently adjudicate V4 for the secondary-email link's GET /api/auth/verify-email?token=secondary-token. Require exact method, endpoint, query, one request per click, and the normal persisted primary and secondary verification states. A printed temporary verifier must preserve the candidate's primary-then-secondary flow and unchanged final both-verified primary assertion. It must target the final secondary verification GET after earlier checkpoints, await a recognized failed response, then visit the profile or otherwise freshly reread persistent state before the unchanged primary assertion turns red for the expected secondary-unverified mismatch. A red status-only or generic navigation assertion is insufficient. Missing evidence is CANNOT_VERIFY, not PASS.
decision_rule.guards: All three calls must complete without infrastructure error, out-of-scope writes, or artifact drift. Report clean 3/3, five fault kills, refactor survival, P0 scan, V6, and final status separately. Manual V4 source/output adjudication is mandatory; an incomplete cell is INCONCLUSIVE.
decision_rule.interpretation: One public handler under dependency doubles, even with two branches and three repetitions, cannot establish generalized lift or full-app/release equivalence. Billed cost is unavailable; elapsed time is descriptive only. Do not change product wording based solely on this case.

prerequisite_probe: Reuse the pinned image's passing model-free successor probe for guarded Chromium CLI, pre-dispatch origin rejection, owned cleanup, and clean smoke tests.
